headline: #Cult is now streaming on Prime Video: OTT release date and where to watch
dek: The Telugu film, starring Vishwak Sen, Gayatri Bhardwaj, Tarak Ponnappa, arrived on Prime Video 19 days after opening in cinemas on 30 October.
paragraphs: #Cult is streaming on Prime Video in India from 18 November.
That is 19 days after its theatrical release on 30 October — 9 days faster than the typical 28 days for Telugu films, based on 16 recent releases tracked by New on OTT.

A group of young boys head to a party expecting a night of fun, but soon discover the reality is far darker than they imagined. What starts as excitement spirals into terror, pushing them into a brutal fight for survival.
Directed by Vishwak Sen, starring Vishwak Sen, Gayatri Bhardwaj, Tarak Ponnappa, Murali Sharma, Srikanth Iyengar. The film runs 152 minutes and is certified A.
New on OTT re-checks Prime Video's India listing every day; the page for #Cult has the latest on where to watch it.
